source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Guaranteed tooth loss from alendronate regardless of dental disease or invasive dental procedures","B":"Osteonecrosis of the jaw, with invasive dental procedures recognized as an important risk factor","C":"Acute bacterial endocarditis caused directly by bisphosphonate deposition in gingival tissue","D":"Severe hypoglycemia caused by temporary interruption of alendronate around the dental procedure"}}
source_row.rationale: Bisphosphonate labeling describes osteonecrosis of the jaw as a rare but serious adverse effect and identifies invasive dental procedures as a risk factor. Management around dental procedures requires individualized clinical judgment.
source_row.source_detail: Warnings and Precautions: Osteonecrosis of the Jaw; invasive dental procedures listed as risk factors; labeling accessed 2026-08-14.
source_row.stem: A client taking oral alendronate is scheduled for a tooth extraction. Which rare medication-related complication is relevant to the dental plan?
